card: Return to a Tajweed or Tafseer lesson at your pace.
title: Tilawah for Quran learning
intro: Tilawah brings recorded Tajweed and Tafseer lessons into a self-paced course. A learner can return to where they left off.

sections.heading: What can you learn in Tilawah?
sections.body: Recorded lessons cover Tajweed and Tafseer.

sections.heading: How does self-paced learning work?
sections.body: A learner follows lessons at their own pace and can track where they reached.

sections.heading: Can a learner book recitation?
sections.body: Live one-to-one recitation can be booked in the learner's own timezone.

sections.heading: Where does Tilawah fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell can hold your own notes and appointments. Tilawah keeps recorded Quran lessons, progress and booked recitation in a learning space.
